provenance.statement: 14 SSE announcements, all filed 2014-12, whose titles state that a risk of delisting-risk-warning and suspension-of-listing EXISTS. GP29 has no 2/3 event near any of them, i.e. no warning was implemented. Before parser v7 they classified as Implement(DelistingRiskWarning); 7 of them left an open interval that has been read as delisting risk warning for about 2,889 trading days.
